assumptions: NEB's published Q5 geometry: non-overlapping primers pointing away from each other, the insert as a 5' tail.
The annealing arms are pydna's `_design_primer` at the target Tm.
limits: An insert must be a whole number of codons; anything else would frameshift everything downstream and is refused.
No reference implementation to grade against exists (NEBaseChanger and SnapGene are closed), so the product is proved by re-simulating the PCR rather than by a golden copy.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which back-to-back primers delete, insert or replace these residues, and what product do they make?

description: Round-the-horn (NEB Q5-style) primers that DELETE, INSERT or REPLACE whole residues of a CDS: the two back-to-back primers, the edited product they make after KLD re-circularisation, and the span they edit on the template. design_mutagenesis_primers covers substitutions; this covers the other three.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

after_residue.description: insert after this residue; 0 inserts before the first. Only applies when edit is insert.

cds_feature.description: the annotated CDS the residue numbers count in, by NAME. Left empty the selection scopes it, and `cds_offset` is taken from the region.

cds_offset.description: 0-based offset of the CDS start within the template, when `template` is given literally. Resolved from the record otherwise. Advanced.

circular.description: the template is circular, which round-the-horn assumes. Taken from the record when one is open.

edit.description: which edit this is. Values: delete (Delete residues), insert (Insert residues), replace (Replace residues).

first_residue.description: 1-based first residue to remove (delete and replace). Only applies when edit is delete or replace.

insert_codons.description: the residues to introduce, as DNA codons in frame. A length that is not a multiple of 3 is refused rather than frameshifting the rest of the protein. Only applies when edit is insert or replace.

last_residue.description: 1-based last residue to remove, inclusive. Only applies when edit is delete or replace.

target_tm.description: annealing Tm each arm is designed to. NEB's Q5 protocol targets ~60 °C. In °C.

template.description: the whole plasmid to amplify. Left empty the open record is used, which is the usual case. Advanced.

tm_model.description: Tm scale the arms are grown against. Values: santalucia (SantaLucia nearest-neighbor (Biopython Tm_NN defaults)), wallace (Wallace rule (4 °C per G·C, 2 °C per A·T)), gc:Chester_1993 (GC formula: Marmur-Doty (Chester & Marshak 1993)), gc:QuickChange (GC formula: QuikChange (the kit manufacturer’s own formula)), gc:Schildkraut_1965 (GC formula: Schildkraut & Lifson 1965 (Marmur-Doty + log[Na⁺])), gc:Wetmur_Melting_1991 (GC formula: Wetmur 1991, DNA (MELTING 4.3 approximate mode)), gc:Wetmur_RNA_1991 (GC formula: Wetmur 1991, RNA), gc:Wetmur_DNA_RNA_1991 (GC formula: Wetmur 1991, RNA/DNA hybrid), gc:Primer3 (GC formula: Primer3Plus product Tm (Biopython’s default set)), gc:Ahsen_2001 (GC formula: von Ahsen 2001 (accuracy against ease of use)).

name: design_indel_primers

editSpan.description: the span edited on the ORIGINAL template, 0-based half-open. Empty for a pure insertion, which removes nothing

forward.description: the forward primer: `seq` as ordered (5' tail + arm), `anneal` (the template-complementary part), its Tm, GC and binding span

kind.description: what the engine classified this as: deletion, insertion or replacement

product.description: the edited molecule these primers produce after amplification and KLD re-circularisation — wire it into a digest, a gel or a map
